purpose: Verify apparent primary-target speed wins on fresh seeds, avoiding claims based only on selecting budgets from five calibration seeds
trigger: Both methods eligible at 20% reference-relative error and calibration mean MG/TWoS-RB time ratio above one
fixed_configurations: Retain selected TWoS budget and strongest selected MG resolution/reuse variant; no retuning on holdout results
timing: Fresh process per method, alternating paired method order; common mesh setup excluded and recorded; edited MG is initialized with the original field before the timed edit
validation: The upper 97.5th percentile bootstrap mean score error must remain <=20%, and the lower 2.5th percentile paired runtime-ratio bootstrap must exceed one for a verified win
scope: Reference gates remain unchanged; pointwise intervals, fixed sites, no continuum-error certificate or universal state-of-the-art claim. Failed confirmations remain reported.
